checks.title: OpenAPI operations without a security requirement
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Every operation declares a security requirement (globally or per operation); public endpoints opt out explicitly with security: [].
checks.remediation: Add a global security requirement and securitySchemes, and mark intentionally public operations with an explicit empty security list.

checks.title: API key or token accepted in the query string
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Credentials travel in headers (Authorization or a custom header), never in URLs that end up in logs and referrers.
checks.remediation: Move apiKey schemes and credential-like parameters to the header location.

checks.title: API server URLs use plain HTTP
checks.expected_secure_behavior: All non-local server URLs in the API contract use HTTPS.
checks.remediation: Declare https:// servers (or remove http from swagger schemes) and redirect/HSTS on the gateway.

checks.title: JWT verification disabled, alg none or audience not validated
checks.expected_secure_behavior: JWTs are verified with a pinned algorithm list, signature, expiry, issuer and audience checks.
checks.remediation: Always verify signatures, pin algorithms, validate exp/iss/aud and remove verify_signature=False / ignoreExpiration / alg none.

checks.title: GraphQL introspection or IDE enabled in production configuration
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Introspection and GraphQL playgrounds are disabled in production.
checks.remediation: Gate introspection/playground/graphiql on a non-production environment flag and require auth for schema access.

checks.title: Mass assignment from request body into models
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Only an explicit allowlist of fields from the request body is bound to a model.
checks.remediation: Bind fields explicitly or use DTO/schema validation with an allowlist; never pass the raw body to Model(**data), Model.create or Object.assign.

checks.title: Broken object-level authorization (two-identity test)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: User B cannot read or modify objects owned by user A by changing object identifiers.
checks.remediation: Enforce object-level ownership checks on every identifier-based route and add a two-identity regression test.

checks.title: Schema conformance fuzzing with Schemathesis
checks.expected_secure_behavior: The implementation conforms to its OpenAPI contract and handles malformed input without 5xx errors.
checks.remediation: Run Schemathesis against a test deployment, fix crashes and contract drift, and keep the run in CI.
